provenance: Native retail 1.20 evaluation of independently chosen wave inputs using synthetic tables, plus generated results from each native noise initializer; no executable or asset bytes.
noiseInitialization: Both native engines seed at 1001, produce 15-bit values with state = state*214013 + 2531011 modulo 2^32, and use float scale words 0x38000100 and 0x3bff01fe. SP probe replaces only its CRT thread-storage lookup with owned storage.
